comparison.objective: Choose, mount, and lock a zoom lens nose-down, then leave it at 50 mm.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual bayonet mounting and friction-aware ring adjustment, not hammer impact or fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Correct lens locked from below, zoom remains at 50 mm after release.
comparison.reason: This tests insertion/rotation and passive setting retention; the candidate tests controlled sacrificial fracture and containment. No spec versions or numeric mount/zoom tolerances are supplied.
